recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic, multi-layered composition featuring a man in a black cowboy hat and suit looking downward, framed within the context of a vintage envelope. The design uses a muted, warm palette with a horizontal black band for the primary artist name and organic, cursive handwriting for the secondary title.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's portrait is nested inside the 'window' of a vintage envelope.
A horizontal black bar bisects the image, providing a high-contrast anchor for typography.
The postmark and stamp elements on the left balance the weight of the portrait on the right.
The contrast between rigid sans-serif type and fluid handwriting reflects the theme of formal identity versus personal correspondence.
coreInvariants: Presence of a black cowboy hat
Envelope-inspired framing with visible edges and postmarks
Horizontal black banner for primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from the waist up, looking down and slightly left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal black bar spanning the middle of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze down to the black bar, then moves left to the stamp/postmark, and finally down to the handwritten title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third of the image serves as functional negative space, styled as the corner of an envelope.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and cream (envelope paper and background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (suit, hat, and horizontal banner).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold or yellow (first word of the artist name).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the black elements and the light paper background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and desaturated blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and casual cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text is all-caps, condensed, with uniform stroke weight.
Secondary text is a loose, connected script mimicking ballpoint pen handwriting.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first name in the primary text is colored differently to create a visual break without changing the font.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between industrial sans-serif and personal handwriting.
graphicDevices: Stamp-like graphic in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, clean sans-serif look for the primary name.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Mistral or a custom signature font
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, ink-on-paper feel of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and suit looking down, desaturated tones. Frame the portrait as if it is inside a vintage, cream-colored envelope. Include a stamp graphic and wavy postmark lines on the left side. Add a solid black horizontal bar across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the artist name in a condensed white sans-serif font inside the black bar, with the first name in gold. Below the bar on the left, add the title in a dark charcoal cursive script that looks like natural handwriting.

verificationChecks: Is the man wearing a black cowboy hat?
Is there a clear horizontal black bar?
Does the left side look like a vintage envelope?
Is the script text tilted slightly upward?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the accent text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black bar does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the script text looks like ink on paper, not a digital overlay.
Check that the color palette remains cohesive and muted.
Confirm the composition feels like a physical object (an envelope).
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a somber portrait with epistolary elements (stamps, postmarks, handwriting) and a bold typographic anchor to create a nostalgic, personal narrative aesthetic.
